metadata.case_name: YI SHENGMAO AND OTHERS v. WONG KAM PIU AND OTHERS

plaintiff.occupation_before: self-employed shrimp farmer aided by his wife

source: The 1st Plaintiff had transient loss of consciousness and did not come to until his admission to the Accident & Emergency Department of United Christian Hospital (“UCH”).
injuries.icd_description: Concussion with loss of consciousness, short duration of less than 30 minutes

injuries.description: comminuted fracture of the left distal humerus
source: X-rays showed comminuted fractures of both the left distal humerus and the left femur sub-trochanteric region.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injuries to the elbow or forearm

injuries.description: comminuted fracture of the left femur sub-trochanteric region
source: X-rays showed comminuted fractures of both the left distal humerus and the left femur sub-trochanteric region.

injuries.description: multiple abrasion wounds over the body
source: On admission, there was swelling of his left arm and left thigh as also multiple abrasion wounds over the body.

injuries.description: 2.5 cm shortening of the left lower limb
source: (iv) 2.5 cm shortening of the left lower limb.

manifestations.description: Left arm pain, numbness in inclement weather or with dependent position for 15 minutes or when holding a rice bowl or 10 lbs
Left buttock and left lateral lower thigh and back of left heel pain, numbing ache that occurred in changes of weather or when sitting during bowel motion or when walking for 15-20 minutes
Tenderness and pain at the node that appeared on the left side of the face after the accident
Lower thoracic down to lumbar spine pain, sharp piercing pain that first appeared in December 2002
Walking with a slight limping gait due to shortening of the left lower limb
Mild wasting of the left gluteus maximus muscle
15 degrees of internal rotation of the left lower limb
Mild reduction of left hip active motions
He walked slowly almost haltingly to and from the witness stand with the help of a walking stick in his right hand for support

treatments_received: open reduction and plating of the humerus fracture
close reduction and intra-medullary nailing of the femur fracture
hospitalisation at United Christian Hospital from 11 August to 3 October 2002
admission to Jueshan Medical Centre in China from 2 November to 30 November 2002 with herbal treatment
medication and injection for about a year

losses.description: Comminuted fractures of the left humerus and left femur which healed but left a recognizable residual disability
Slight limping gait owing to 2.5 cm shortening of the left lower limb
